title: Sumo
description: Push your friends off the platform. Drag to shove your puck, bump the others over the edge, and be the last one standing. The ring shrinks, so nobody hides for long. 2–8 players, first to 3 rounds.

achievements.title: Flawless
achievements.description: Win a match without losing a single round.

achievements.title: Ring Out
achievements.description: Push 3 opponents off the platform in one match.

achievements.title: Full House
achievements.description: Finish a match in a room of 6 or more players.
